A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a courier for the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]], while the courier was under the employ of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] controlled [[Unidentified Hutt-controlled company|company]]. The Human was suppose to deliver a satchel full of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to a [[Prit Kessek|another courier]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Bazarre]], but was instead captured while in the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] worked for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] controlled [[Unidentified Hutt-controlled company|company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]]. While working for the company he acted as a courier for the wealthy shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]], shortly after Taug had been secretly arrested. The man was ordered to deliver a case full of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to another courier, a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] named [[Prit Kessek]], on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]]. Kessek would then deliver them to the [[Thanda clan]] of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], to fund the upkeep of a fleet of [[slaveship]] Taug had invested in. These payments were made in regular installments but using a different bagman each time. The courier planned to reach Bazarre after traveling with a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Unidentified Houk bodyguard|bodyguard]] from the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Junction to the planets [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and then [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]] before reaching his destination.<ref name="ZT" />

{{RPG}}
The Human courier however had been set up, as Taug had revealed that the credits would be being delivered to his captors, Intelligence agents interested in bringing down the slaver clan. To do so they planned to replace the bagman with their own agents, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] they had hired. To this end the spacers staked out the Grand Terminal, while intelligence agents tracked the courier and his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] progress on Junction. When the pair reached the spaceport, a false announcement warned the spacers of the couriers presence and they captured him and delivered him to the intelligence agents. The man broke quickly under interrogation and revealed his travel plans, the codes to the case and his instructions to the agents, who informed the spacers.<ref name="ZT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
The bagman carrier a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] while acting as courier, along with and encrypted [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and the satchel of credits.<ref name="ZT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bagman first appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released as an online supplement by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]]. In the adventure there are multiple possible ways for players to attempt to try and subdue the bagman, with failure a possibility, but this article assumes players were successfully alerted to his presence and proceeded to successfully capture him without killing him, the aim of the encounter.
